summary: STANDARD THAT APPLIES: DYNAMIXEL Protocol 2.0 (ROBOTIS-published, open bus protocol). E1 Control Table 'Protocol Type(13) | RW | 2 | 2 ~ 22' - the part ships speaking Protocol 2.0, and Pollen's robotd drives it with rustypot .with_protocol_v2() at 1 Mbps (bus.rs:110-112). The artifact is the vendor's Protocol 2.0 specification page fetched 2026-09-02. Outcome is CANNOT DETERMINE on purpose: nothing here has been measured - no packet was put on a bus by this workshop; the row records which published protocol governs the DATA line so a bus check knows what document to hold the HAT's transceiver and robotd's packets to. Not an ISO/DIN/JIS standard; T4 is not claimed.

VENDOR CONFORMITY STATEMENT, on the vendor's own word: E1 §Certifications verbatim 'FCC Note: This equipment has been tested and found to comply with the limits for a Class A digital device, pursuant to part 15 of the FCC Rules.' (47 CFR Part 15, Class A). No CE, KC, RoHS or REACH statement is on the page ('Please inquire us for information regarding unlisted certifications'). The Microduck as a consumer product would need Class B, not Class A, and its own conformity - this row is the servo vendor's claim about the servo, artifact = the fetched page. Nothing measured here, hence CANNOT DETERMINE.
